about: Opt-in packs. Brain pages join a pack through `pack:` in their frontmatter; skills, scripts and workflows join through `paths` below. Lines in CLAUDE.md and README.md that end in <!-- pack:NAME --> belong to that pack too. `node scripts/packs.mjs list` shows them, `node scripts/packs.mjs remove NAME` deletes one cleanly. `removed` records what the user declined, so /update-aios never brings it back.
